// Deliberate C2 violations. Every exec call below must be reported.
//
// Kept as .go.txt so the Go build never compiles it — a fixture that compiled would
// mean the agent ships code that knows how to run a shell, which is the thing the
// check exists to prevent. A scanner with no fixtures proving it fires is a scanner
// nobody has tested, and this project has already shipped one of those.
package fixture

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
)

// want: shell-interpreter formatted-process-argument
func obviousShell(slug string) {
	exec.Command("sh", "-c", "useradd "+slug)
}

// want: shell-interpreter formatted-process-argument
func absolutePath(slug string) {
	exec.Command("/bin/bash", "-c", fmt.Sprintf("rm -rf /srv/%s", slug))
}

// want: shell-interpreter
func viaEnv(slug string) {
	exec.Command("/usr/bin/env", "sh", "-c", slug)
}

// want: shell-interpreter
func withContext(ctx context.Context, slug string) {
	exec.CommandContext(ctx, "zsh", "-c", slug)
}

// want: formatted-process-argument
func sprintfIntoAnArgument(slug string) {
	exec.Command("useradd", fmt.Sprintf("--home=/srv/%s", slug))
}

// want: formatted-process-argument
func concatenationIntoAnArgument(slug string) {
	exec.Command("useradd", "--home=/srv/"+slug)
}

// want: formatted-process-argument
func joinIntoAnArgument(parts []string) {
	exec.Command("systemctl", strings.Join(parts, " "))
}

// want: formatted-process-argument
func embeddedScript() {
	exec.Command("python3", `
import os
os.system("id")
`)
}

// want: shell-interpreter
func rawSyscall(slug string) {
	_ = syscall.Exec("/bin/sh", []string{"sh", "-c", slug}, nil)
}

// want: formatted-process-argument
func bareAnnotationDoesNotPermit(slug string) {
	//ratline:allow-formatted-arg
	exec.Command("useradd", fmt.Sprintf("--home=/srv/%s", slug))
}
